title: Ram Tah Mission : Decoding the Ancient Ruins
excerpt: Note: This mission is currently (as of 3.0) bugged. Obelisks now show the items required for a scan - see the Decrypting the Guardian Logs mission for a set of obelisk glyphs - but they don't always show the correct items.
